title: Michelle J Probable NDE 3835
content: I was living with my parents at the time (failed marriage - tried to re-establish myself financially). I had just arrived home from my evening workout and noticed that the growth on my collarbone had increased in size. It was very uncomfortable!!! I knew that I would have to sleep on four pillows in order to get a good night's rest. I woke up during the night struggling to breathe - I also remember the pain in my collarbone - it was extremely uncomfortable. Suddenly, I had floated upwards to the area of the ceiling in my room that was located near the bedroom window. I looked down and could see my body!!! Of course, I had no idea what had just happened, but I noticed a black figure laying over me - I immediately thought that this figure was directly connected to the reason why I had gravitated to the ceiling - at that point - I knew that the figure was death. Suddenly, the room became literally black - the blackness was so deep that it could be cut with a knife. I was afraid of the blackness - and there appeared to be a presence in the blackness that made my hair stand up on my head!!! At that time, I was still thinking in terms of having a body. Suddenly, I began to call out the name of Jesus - very softly - it almost sounded musical - it was very sweet. Then without warning, I began to see what had appeared to be a 'pin-like' hole that appeared very, very bright! It began to burn into the blackness until the darkness was gone! It was life-like. I found myself in a life-like light that was beyond brilliance. There are no words that can fully articulate the light, except it was light that I had seen for the very first time. Only, you not only seen the light, you had become a part of the light. I began to look for my hands and feet but there was nothing! Then I noticed there was a presence there with me that was so familiar. I had known this presence forever - or so it seemed. The presence knew me. The light could have consumed me, but no harm came to me. There was pure love in the light. I was at peace and my mind was totally opened in receiving whatever the presence in the light had to give. I totally trusted the presence (God) because I had remembered the light, for some reason. It was awesome! There was a sound in the light. It was very faint but also soothing. The Presence in the light (God) began to communicate telepathically to my mind and I was permitted to respond telepathically, even though He had already known what my response would be. I was given the question, if I would like to return. I thought about it and then I began to think about my parents and how 'freaked' they would be if they were to discovery my body in bed. So, I opted to return, but I asked if I could remember the experience - without notice, I was suddenly back into my body. It was as if I had gone through a vacuum and was sucked back into my body. It was beyond time or speed. One just could not measure it because it was beyond any earthly thing. After that experience, I became depressed because I wanted to return. I have had other experiences since then, but I can say that my life was totally transformed. I was healed, received supernatural abilities involving knowledge and had a sudden hunger for knowledge. Even now, I'm in school and also teaching in Church. I'm working on a book. In the meantime, when I have those experiences, I try to write them down. Sometimes, it really is hard to articulate, besides, who would ever believe that these experiences continue. I also share my experience with the light with people who are hopeless and full of despair.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Described as going 'through a vacuum' and being 'sucked back' into the body, 'beyond time or speed.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Woke struggling to breathe with painful, enlarging growth on collarbone.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also described an intervening phase of total blackness with a frightening presence and a black figure perceived as 'death' over her body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE to ceiling with view of body, then total blackness/void, then emergence of a bright 'pin-like' hole expanding into brilliant light with a familiar Presence (God), then offered choice to return and rapid vacuum-like return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived a 'black figure' laying over her body that she identified as death; darkness described as 'so deep that it could be cut with a knife'; light began as a bright 'pin-like' hole burning through the darkness.

I looked down and could see my body!!!"; "Suddenly, the room became literally black - the blackness was so deep that it could be cut with a knife."; "Then without warning, I began to see what had appeared to be a 'pin-like' hole that appeared very, very bright!"; "Only, you not only seen the light, you had become a part of the light."; "It was as if I had gone through a vacuum and was sucked back into my body."
